title: Secret-backed LLM gateway and health-probe headers
intent: Allow LLM routes and external backend health probes to use encrypted Bahia secrets without persisting or publishing plaintext credentials.
security_invariants: LLM route and release state contains only secret UUID references.
Plaintext is resolved only immediately before the outbound gateway update or health request.
Every resolution uses the existing versioned secret-access audit path.
A header cannot have both a literal value and a secret reference.
